_about: Gameplay geometry, in the same units as levels.json and rules.md (the prototype's 320x180 stage).
These numbers decide what a tap hits. They never come from sprite sizes, so art can be replaced freely.
Cover sizes (hitbox width, and the height an outlaw hides behind) stay in the kit's data/cover_sizes.json.
pad values grow a hitbox on each side: 'touch' for fingers, 'mouse' for desktop testing.

layout._about: The gameplay plane follows the brief v2 scale guide: a standing outlaw is 22% of the screen height (38 of 180 units) and a barrel 13% (23 units); hit areas here and cover_sizes below are scaled with them. Prototype levels (positions measured at the prototype's sizes) spread their cover about its own middle just enough that the bigger cover doesn't overlap (with gap units between), then slides it inside the safe area (units: the 16:9 screen less a margin, and clear of the revolver in the bottom-right corner). Its bottles, hostages and sign move with it, and its blast radii are multiplied by the same spread.

cover_sizes._about: Overrides the kit's cover_sizes.json at the brief v2 scale (barrel 13% of the screen height; the other props keep their size against it): [hit width, height an outlaw hides behind].

scenes._about: Overrides for the kit's scenes.json, measured on the painted art. Main Street (assets/painted/main_street.png) is drawn 720 pixels tall and centred, so 1 painting pixel = 0.877 screen pixels: windows are the dark openings between the shutters of the saloon's and bank's upper floors, and the ground line is the dirt in front of the boardwalks.

outlaw._peek: Over cover he shows hide_gap + peek_up units of his 38: head, hat and gun (brief v2 §10).

window_outlaw._about: Upper body only, cropped at the sill, filling 70% of the window: he is drawn at figure_scale (upstairs is further away) and shows from exposed_from_top down.

sign._v2: Puzzle-first levels: a falling sign crushes only who stands under its board, and sets off TNT it lands on.

tnt._about: Radii at no spread; each level multiplies them by its layout spread (see layout), so blasts reach exactly what they did in the prototype.

gun._about: Small and low in the bottom-right corner (style guide). The pivot is the gun art's anchor (the painted glove's cuff), placed just past the screen's corner. Angles are added to the barrel's own angle in the art (manifest barrel_angle) and kept small: the gun only nods towards the target.

iron_eli._about: rules.md section 8. Spots are where he appears in stage 2: a window index (w) or a cover index (c).

bucket._about: Target Practice: a bucket hanging from a beam on a post. A shot at it or its rope drops it; it breaks the bottles under it.

walker._about: Outlaws on a fixed route (brief v2 patrols): speed comes from the level, in units a second. The walk cycle (two steps) shows one frame per frame_step units walked, with a bob (units) at mid-step: art only.

hanging._about: Art only: how hanging things are hung. A signpost stands beside what it holds (mirrored to the other side when it would leave the screen or stand on a bench), with the hang point along its arm; a wall bracket holds it if no signpost fits. Chains are repeated links; the bucket hangs from a hook.
